item.title: MSF says it will not share staff details demanded by Israel to access Gaza
item.description: GENEVA (Reuters): Medical charity Medecins Sans Frontieres said on Friday it will not submit lists of staff demanded by Israel to maintain access to Gaza and the West Bank, saying it had not been able to obtain assurances over the safety of its teams.
